verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon). It has no user-facing data or interface of its own, so getting AI-generated insights from your data inside the product is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers only NPU TOPS, Copilot+ PC positioning and AI Hub developer tooling. These are hardware and developer building blocks, not a shipped insights feature, so the exception for a wrong-axis capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
